'''Pokémon Adventures: Bruno's Battle''' is the 37th monthly issue released by [[VIZ Media]] of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga created by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and [[Mato]]. It contains chapters 44 and 45 of the {{MangaArc|Yellow}}. The chapters originally released in this book were later rereleased as part of {{PAV|7}}. As a bonus, it contained a sheet of Pokémon stickers which were not included with the collected volume release.

==Important events==
* {{adv|Green}} tells [[Lorelei]] her plan to have {{adv|Yellow}} find {{adv|Red}}.
* Red defeats [[Bruno]].
* Red is broken out of the ice by {{adv|Giovanni}} and is given a [[Spoons of Destiny|Spoon of Destiny]].
* Red gets his [[Pokédex]] back.
* Blue tries to fight [[Agatha]] and her {{TP|Agatha|Gengar}}.
* Agatha reveals some of the plan of the Elite Four.
